capture_mode: conservative saved EIG to PropertyAuctions and HM Land Registry cross-source address enrichment
source_note: All saved addressless EIG manifest appearances for Savills auction 17999 were reconciled against the separately banked Savills/PropertyAuctions AID 920 results and their preserved official HM Land Registry address evidence. Fifty-one appearances were enriched only where auction date, exact sold price, postcode district, tenure and property class produced exactly one compatible addressed lot. Addressless, unsold, multi-candidate and non-compatible rows remain unchanged. The EIG and PropertyAuctions appearances remain separate source records, and all original evidence is preserved.

source_records.evidence_excerpt: The saved public manifest provides stable lot IDs, exact results, postcode districts, tenure and detailed property classes.
